summary: Ceres Unified School District urges the FCC to reject any proposal that would terminate or limit the E‑Rate program, arguing that E‑Rate funding has been essential for building broadband infrastructure, supporting a district‑wide device program, and enabling a wide range of educational services while addressing screen‑time concerns through intentional use. Ceres Unified School District urges continued E‑Rate funding to maintain equitable access to technology and learning opportunities.
